XX and XY complements alter gene dosage, epigenetic programming, immune signaling, metabolism, and cellular stress responses, which shape aging and disease trajectories in women and men.

digest: Gut microbiome plays an important role in human health.
Urbanization has been suggested to alter the gut microbiome.
We comprehensively evaluated differences in gut microbiome profiles of 76 urban and 81 rural female residents of Vietnam using shotgun metagenomic data.

9592ac5e1560e445.title: Multiomic analysis of malignant ascites defines RORC-expressing dendritic cells at sites of metastasis.
digest: Here, we performed multiomic analyses on ascites samples from patients with cancer and identified RORC-expressing dendritic cells (RORC DCs) enriched in malignant ascites.

We devised a high-purity sorting strategy to enable in vitro experiments with patient-derived RORC DCs, which indicated that these cells were phenotypically stable and stimulated T cell proliferation while attenuating IFNG expression.

7ffec209f5a02a00.title: Quantifying the Resource Landscape That Shapes the Human Gut Microbiome
digest: The microbial ecosystem in the human gut is fundamentally shaped by the resources it receives.
Yet, while quantitative information is available for many individual resource fluxes, a comprehensive description of the overall resource landscape is lacking.
Resource supply also determines whether microbial auxotrophies impose physiological constraints.
